A_base.base: woman, age 25, neutral expression, clear bright eyes with dark defined limbal rings, hair tied back, no make-up, plain dark crew neck

A_noring.edit: eyes only: remove the dark ring around the edge of both irises so the iris fades softly into the white

A_yellow.edit: eyes only: whites of the eyes slightly yellowed and faintly bloodshot

A_both.edit: eyes only: whites of the eyes slightly yellowed and faintly bloodshot

B_base.base: woman, age 48, neutral expression, eyes with naturally faint limbal rings, hair tied back, no make-up, grey crew neck

beats.caption: SAME FACE. **ONE THING** CHANGED?
beats.vo: Same face, and we erased just one thing, so can you see what changed?

beats.caption: THE **LIMBAL RING**
beats.vo: Look at the thin dark ring around the outer edge of each iris.

beats.caption: THE **LIMBAL RING**
beats.vo: Up close, that ring frames the iris and makes the eye look sharp and clear.

beats.caption: THE **LIMBAL RING**
beats.vo: Erase it, and the same eye suddenly looks flatter, softer and a little older.

beats.caption: THE **LIMBAL RING**
beats.vo: Faces with visible limbal rings were rated more attractive.

beats.caption: THE **WHITES**
beats.vo: Now look at the whites, which stay bright and clean in young, healthy eyes.

beats.caption: THE **WHITES**
beats.vo: Doctors call this part the sclera, and its colour shifts with health and age.

beats.caption: THE **WHITES**
beats.vo: Add a faint yellow tint and a few red veins, and she starts to look unwell.

beats.caption: THE **WHITES**
beats.vo: Yellower, redder whites made the same faces look older.

beats.caption: IT **FADES**
beats.vo: Limbal rings fade on their own with age, which is part of why they matter.

beats.caption: IT **FADES**
beats.vo: At forty-eight her rings are thinner and paler than they were in her twenties.

beats.caption: IT **FADES**
beats.vo: With less contrast around the iris, the eye blends into the white.

beats.caption: IT **FADES**
beats.vo: Nobody notices the ring itself, only that the face looks a little more tired.

beats.caption: **25** VS 48
beats.vo: Side by side, the younger ring is darker, thicker and far more defined.

beats.caption: **25** VS 48
beats.vo: The older ring has thinned out, so the iris melts into the white.

beats.caption: **25** VS 48
beats.vo: Our edit simply copied what time does to every eye eventually.

beats.caption: **BOTH** EDITS
beats.vo: Now stack both edits on one face and put it next to the original.

beats.caption: **BOTH** EDITS
beats.vo: Same bones, same skin, same expression, and one face looks clearly less healthy.

beats.caption: **BOTH** EDITS
beats.vo: That is the whole trick, and most people cannot name what changed.

beats.caption: **ONE THING?**
beats.vo: Neither edit touches a single bone.

beats.caption: IT'S **HEALTH**
beats.vo: Tiny signs of health are what the eye reads as attractive.

beats.caption: IT'S **HEALTH**
beats.vo: Comment which edit you noticed first.
